body:
## Problem and change

Addresses both review findings from #55:

- A YimeCore package could have a self-consistent manifest while omitting `profile-icon.ico` or one of the three native runtime tools, then fail at registration/startup. Require all four resources during package validation; Rime/PIME requirements remain independent.
- Setup ignored a failed `InstallLayoutOrTip(..., 1)` call and could delete the installed payload. Check the result before COM unregistration, startup cleanup, and file deletion, preserving those resources on refusal.

## Validation

- Windows PowerShell 5.1: new package and profile-removal regressions reproduced the original failures and pass after the fix.
- Synthetic fixtures cover complete independent packages and each omitted resource; simulated profile removal covers both products, success/refusal, registration present/absent, and downloaded/installed maintenance resource paths.
- Existing logging and single/both-product dispatch tests passed; Setup static preflight, build contract, workflow contract tests, and whitespace checks passed.
- Added both regressions to the required `simple-installer` CI job.

No live installation or input acceptance was performed. HANDOFF records that the historical package does not contain these fixes and no new test-PC installation is requested.

Original findings: [package resources](https://github.com/tsaanghwang/Yime/pull/55#discussion_r4010822738), [profile removal](https://github.com/tsaanghwang/Yime/pull/55#discussion_r4010822775).
title: fix(installer): address PR 55 package and profile removal findings
